summary.intent: Plan Phase 26 (Observability & UX Tuning) by running the gsd plan-phase workflow, which includes researching Grafana alerting thresholds and timeout tuning approaches before generating executable PLAN.md files.
summary.outcome: CONTEXT.md was successfully created capturing all design decisions from the discuss-phase session, and the plan-phase workflow was initiated through the research step — a researcher agent was spawned but the transcript ends before research or planning completed.

repo: Phase 26 is 'Observability & UX Tuning' focused on Grafana alerting thresholds and timeout tuning for sub-2s UX targets
Alert thresholds use a two-tier model: Warning at p95, Critical at p99/2x p95, with DB fallback rate alert at >20%
Four monitored operations: IPNS resolve, IPFS pin, API endpoints, IPNS publish
Grafana alert rules are stored as code in docker/grafana/ provisioning files
Validation strategy uses local + staging dual validation, rerunning Phase 22 journey tests and load harness

code.finding: CONTEXT.md created with decisions on alert thresholds, delivery, timeout tuning targets (sub-2s for upload-to-visible, vault/folder load, download-to-open), and validation approach

workflow: The gsd plan-phase workflow gates: init → validate phase → load CONTEXT.md → ask about research → spawn researcher → spawn planner → verify with plan-checker → revision loop
AskUserQuestion is used to prompt the user about whether to research before planning
CONTEXT.md from discuss-phase is passed to all downstream agents (researcher, planner, checker)
